title: Student V0.1 JOB09 — G5 human replay and student-readiness gate
purpose: Prepare an identity-bound human replay from the exact G4 candidate, obtain an explicit real-human G5 decision on student readiness, and durably record that decision without modifying the candidate.
invariants: JOB09 is a human gate. Automation prepares evidence but cannot substitute for the human verdict.
The learner candidate under review is exactly G4 RESULT_SHA 757ed15e840bfca603de0eac3bef1e9d5ff3483d; JOB09 does not create a new product candidate.
The human replay uses the exact 496658-byte package with SHA-256 a3d3db4c63fae89b47e1d7a1341ebb522f31df69e1b107ada2ecbb9a11c4ac10 rebuilt from the exact G4 candidate.
The outer human-replay bundle may contain reviewer-only protocol/guide/decision artifacts, but the nested learner package bytes remain exact and immutable.
Reviewer-only answer guidance must stay outside the learner package and must not be opened before the cold-start segment is complete.
Phase A must stop with HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED and may not infer or manufacture human observations.
Phase B requires an explicit human decision bound to exact candidate and replay-bundle identities.
A human GO requires a complete learner journey plus the mandatory readiness dimensions; automation PASS alone is insufficient.
Human HOLD findings are not repaired in JOB09. They are classified and returned to the owning role or Control Room.
No main merge, release promotion, or broader student rollout is authorized by JOB09.
G5 PASS authorizes only the first limited 5–6 real student sessions on this exact candidate/package.
requiredEvidence: Fresh HCP/main/G4 PR binding before replay preparation.
G4 RESULT_SHA and EVIDENCE_HEAD exact ancestry and durable qualification revalidated.
Exact app rebuilt twice and matched to 478657 bytes / SHA256 85dbeeef4207c9e4deb846d2b2e15f1e6979b1d32144ead3c1097bd5bf15630e.
Exact repaired showcase SHA256 verified.
Exact pilot package rebuilt twice and matched to 496658 bytes / SHA256 a3d3db4c63fae89b47e1d7a1341ebb522f31df69e1b107ada2ecbb9a11c4ac10.

Transient outer replay bundle contains exact nested learner package, identity record, cold-start protocol, reviewer-only answer guide, accessibility/recovery protocol, decision form, and hash verifier.
Replay packet committed in Git binds candidate SHA, nested package hash, outer replay-bundle hash, protocol version and mandatory human dimensions.
Human reviewer verifies the exact replay identity before testing.
Cold-start segment is completed without reviewer answer guide.
Human completes the full 11-activity / 30–45 minute journey.
Human tests at least one intentional wrong scored answer and judges feedback clarity/trust.
Human verifies reload/resume and completion persistence.
Human tests invalid/canceled import recovery and judges recovery clarity.
Human performs desktop pointer/keyboard interaction and a mobile touch replay/smoke on the exact candidate.
Human performs a real screen-reader smoke with one of NVDA, VoiceOver or TalkBack over start/import, one activity/feedback state and completion.
Human records each mandatory dimension as PASS or HOLD, with blocker/major/minor findings.
Human gives an explicit final GO_LIMITED_PILOT or HOLD decision.
Human GO explicitly authorizes only the first 5–6 student sessions and binds the exact replay/candidate identity.
Human decision is committed as a dedicated immutable evidence file before final JOB09 result.
Repository governance and exact scope pass on review-only branch.
adversarialTests: An AI/model cannot mark a human dimension PASS based solely on prior automated evidence.
A screenshot, DOM probe or automated browser run cannot substitute for the required human interaction observations.
Opening the reviewer answer guide before the cold-start segment invalidates cold-start comprehensibility evidence and requires replay restart.
Reviewing a package whose SHA-256 differs from the exact G4 package invalidates the G5 decision.
A GO statement that is not explicitly tied to the exact candidate/replay bundle is insufficient.
A GO with any unresolved blocker or major finding is invalid.
A human HOLD must not trigger product/QA/showcase/pilot repair inside JOB09.
Minor findings may be carried only if the human explicitly marks them non-blocking for the limited 5–6-student pilot and records any guardrail.
A human decision to broaden deployment beyond the first limited pilot is outside this gate.
No mutation of candidate/product/payload/workflow paths is permitted.
nonGoals: Changing or merging the G4 candidate.
Starting more than the first 5–6 student sessions.
independentReview: The human reviewer directly experiences the exact G4 package rather than relying on machine summaries.
Cold-start evaluation is protected from answer-guide priming.
Real keyboard, touch and screen-reader interaction covers qualities explicitly not replaceable by automation.
The durable human decision binds exact candidate/package/replay hashes and cannot be inferred from machine PASS.
rollback: Close the JOB09 PR and delete student-v01/g5-human-readiness. G4 candidate/evidence remain unchanged; no product rollback is required because JOB09 is review-only.
